name: Steak and Eggs Skillet with Sauteed Mushrooms
instructions: Pat the steak dry and season with black pepper and smoked paprika. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over high heat and sear the steak 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, then rest. In the same pan, add ghee and mushrooms with garlic and thyme, cooking 5 minutes until browned. Fry the eggs in the remaining oil to your liking. Slice the steak and serve alongside eggs and mushrooms.

name: Egg White Veggie Scramble with White Rice
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and saute the bell pepper and cabbage with garlic and cumin for 4-5 minutes until softened. Pour in the egg whites and gently scramble for 2-3 minutes until just set, seasoning with black pepper. Warm the white rice and plate it alongside the scramble. Finish with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lemon for brightness without salt.

name: Big Breakfast Burrito with Chorizo
instructions: Cook the chorizo in a skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes until crisp, then set aside. Whisk the eggs with cumin and scramble in olive oil for 2-3 minutes until soft. Warm the tortilla, then layer eggs, chorizo, black beans, cheese, and salsa down the center. Sprinkle with smoked paprika and cilantro, fold in the sides, and roll tightly. Sear seam-side down in the pan for 1 minute to seal.

name: Coconut Chia Pudding with Berries
instructions: Whisk together the chia seeds, coconut milk, vanilla, maple syrup, and cinnamon in a jar. Stir well, wait 5 minutes, and stir again to prevent clumping. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight until thick and pudding-like. Top with fresh berries and lemon zest before serving.

name: Spinach and Feta Omelette
instructions: Whisk the eggs with black pepper and a pinch of nutmeg until frothy. Melt butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat, add spinach, and wilt for 1 minute. Pour in the eggs, tilting the pan to spread evenly, and cook 2-3 minutes until nearly set. Scatter feta and dill over one half, fold the omelette, and slide onto a plate.

name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken with Green Beans and Rice
instructions: Marinate the chicken in 1 tbsp olive oil, lemon juice, zest, garlic, oregano, and black pepper for 15 minutes. Grill or pan-sear over medium-high heat 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through, then rest and slice. Steam or saute the green beans in the remaining olive oil for 5 minutes until tender-crisp. Serve the chicken over warm white rice with green beans, finishing with parsley and extra lemon.

name: Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowl
instructions: Toss the chicken with olive oil, cumin, coriander, turmeric, and paprika and marinate 20 minutes. Sear in a hot skillet 5-6 minutes per side until charred and cooked through, then slice. Thin the tahini with lemon juice and a splash of water to make a drizzling sauce. Build the bowl with rice, chicken, cucumber, and red onion, then drizzle with tahini sauce and top with parsley.

name: Quinoa Chickpea Power Salad
instructions: Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon, cumin, and black pepper to make the dressing. Combine cooked quinoa, chickpeas, arugula, and shredded carrot in a bowl. Toss everything with the dressing until evenly coated. Finish with fresh mint and serve chilled or at room temperature.

name: Turkey and Avocado Lettuce Wraps
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high and cook the ground turkey with garlic and ginger for 6-7 minutes, breaking it up until browned. Stir in coconut aminos and chili flakes and cook 1 more minute. Spoon the turkey into lettuce leaves and top with avocado slices. Garnish with green onion and serve as handheld wraps.

name: Hearty Beef and Cabbage Stew over Rice
instructions: Season the beef with paprika, cumin, and black pepper, then brown in olive oil in a pot over medium-high heat for 5 minutes. Add garlic, carrot, and broth, cover, and simmer 45 minutes until beef is tender. Stir in the cabbage and cook another 10 minutes until softened. Serve the stew ladled over white rice and finish with fresh parsley.

name: Mediterranean Tuna and White Bean Bowl
instructions: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, and black pepper into a dressing. Flake the tuna into a bowl and add beans, spinach, and cucumber. Toss with the dressing until well combined. Top with fresh parsley and serve at room temperature.

name: Baked Cod with Cauliflower and Rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400F. Toss cauliflower with 1 tbsp olive oil, garlic, and thyme and roast on a sheet pan for 20 minutes. Place the cod on the pan, drizzle with remaining oil, lemon juice, zest, and black pepper, and bake 12-14 minutes until flaky. Serve over warm white rice with the roasted cauliflower, finishing with fresh dill and lemon zest.

name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta
instructions: Cook the fettuccine in salted water until al dente, then drain and reserve some pasta water. Season and sear the sliced chicken in olive oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until golden, then set aside. In the same pan saute garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, and Italian herbs, then pour in cream and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in spinach, parmesan, chili flakes, and the chicken, then toss with the pasta, loosening with pasta water and finishing with black pepper.

name: Vegan Chickpea Coconut Curry with Rice
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat and saute the onion, garlic, and ginger for 4 minutes until fragrant. Stir in curry powder, cumin, turmeric, and coriander and toast for 30 seconds. Add tomato, chickpeas, and coconut milk, then simmer for 15 minutes until thickened. Serve over basmati rice topped with fresh cilantro.

name: Garlic Herb Pork Chop with Sauteed Cabbage and Rice
instructions: Season the pork chop with rosemary, garlic, and black pepper and let sit 10 minutes. Sear in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through, then rest. In the same pan saute the cabbage in remaining oil for 6 minutes, finishing with apple cider vinegar for brightness. Serve the pork over white rice alongside the cabbage, topped with parsley.

name: Salmon with Lemon Butter and Asparagus
instructions: Pat the salmon dry and season with black pepper. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high and sear salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip and cook 3 more minutes. Add asparagus, butter, and garlic to the pan and cook 4 minutes until asparagus is tender. Spoon the garlic butter over the salmon, finish with lemon juice, zest, and dill, and serve.

name: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Enchilada Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400F and roast the diced sweet potato tossed with olive oil, cumin, paprika, and chili powder for 20 minutes. Mash lightly with the black beans and spoon onto torn corn tortillas in a baking dish. Pour enchilada sauce over the top and sprinkle with cheese. Bake 15 minutes until bubbly and finish with fresh cilantro.

name: Greek Yogurt with Honey and Walnuts
instructions: Spoon the Greek yogurt into a bowl. Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with chopped walnuts. Dust with cinnamon and orange zest, then serve immediately.

name: Cucumber Hummus Snack Plate
instructions: Spoon the hummus into a small bowl and drizzle with olive oil. Dust with smoked paprika and add a squeeze of lemon. Arrange sliced cucumber and bell pepper around the bowl for dipping and garnish with parsley.

name: Deviled Egg Bites
instructions: Halve the hard-boiled eggs and scoop the yolks into a bowl. Mash the yolks with mayo, Dijon, and black pepper until smooth. Spoon or pipe the mixture back into the egg whites. Dust with smoked paprika and top with chopped chives before serving.

name: Cinnamon Apple Steel-Cut Oats with Almond Butter
instructions: Bring water to a boil and stir in the steel-cut oats, reducing heat to a gentle simmer. Cook for about 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until creamy and tender. Add the diced apple, cinnamon, and nutmeg in the last 5 minutes of cooking. Spoon into a bowl, swirl in the almond butter and maple syrup, and top with ground flaxseed before serving.

name: Egg White and Bell Pepper Rice Bowl
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and saute the diced bell pepper for 3 minutes until softened. Pour in the egg whites, season with garlic powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper, and scramble gently for 2-3 minutes until set. Warm the white rice and pile it into a bowl. Top with the scrambled egg whites and peppers, and finish with fresh chives.

name: Smoked Salmon Avocado Keto Plate
instructions: Fry the eggs in olive oil over medium heat until the whites are set but yolks remain runny, about 3 minutes. Arrange the smoked salmon and sliced avocado on a plate alongside the eggs. Scatter capers and fresh dill over the top and season with black pepper. Serve with a lemon wedge to squeeze over.

name: Tofu Scramble with Cabbage and White Rice
instructions: Press the tofu to remove excess water, then crumble it into a bowl. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and saute the shredded cabbage for 4 minutes until softened. Add the crumbled tofu, turmeric, cumin, and garlic powder, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until heated through and fragrant. Serve over warm white rice and garnish with chopped parsley.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Protein Bowl
instructions: Stir the protein powder and vanilla extract into the Greek yogurt until smooth and fully blended. Spoon into a bowl and top with mixed berries and chia seeds. Drizzle with honey just before serving.

name: Loaded Sausage and Potato Breakfast Skillet
instructions: Heat olive oil in a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat and add the diced potatoes, cooking for 12 minutes until golden and crisp. Add the diced onion and sliced sausage, cooking another 6 minutes until browned. Season with smoked paprika and garlic powder, then make two wells and crack in the eggs. Sprinkle cheddar over the top, cover, and cook 4 minutes until eggs are set. Garnish with scallions and serve hot from the skillet.

name: Turkey and White Rice Power Lunch Bowl
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the ground turkey breast for 6 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks. Add the green beans and bell pepper and saute for 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Season with cumin, coriander, and lemon juice, stirring to combine. Serve over warm white rice and finish with fresh cilantro.

name: Chicken and Cauliflower Rice Keto Bowl
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the diced chicken thigh for 7 minutes until golden and cooked through, seasoning with smoked paprika, garlic powder, and cumin. Remove the chicken and add the remaining oil with the cauliflower rice and bell pepper, sauteing for 5 minutes until tender. Return the chicken to the pan and toss to combine. Serve with chopped parsley and a lemon wedge.

name: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat and saute the onion, carrot, and celery for 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika and cook 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in the vegetable broth and lentils, bring to a simmer, and cook for 15 minutes to meld the flavors. Stir in lemon juice at the end and garnish with chopped parsley before serving.

name: Big Beef Burrito with Rice and Beans
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat for 7 minutes, seasoning with cumin, chili powder, and garlic powder. Warm the tortilla in a dry pan for 20 seconds per side to make it pliable. Layer the rice, beans, beef, cheese, salsa, avocado, and sour cream down the center of the tortilla. Fold in the sides and roll tightly into a burrito, then sear seam-side down in the pan for 1 minute to seal.

name: Lemon Herb Shrimp and White Rice
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and add the garlic and chili flakes, cooking 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Add the green beans and saute for 3 minutes, then stir in lemon zest and lemon juice. Serve over warm white rice with a sprinkle of fresh parsley.

name: Roasted Vegetable Quinoa Salad
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425F and toss the zucchini, bell pepper, and chickpeas with 1 tbsp olive oil, oregano, and cumin. Roast on a sheet pan for 22 minutes until caramelized and tender. Combine the roasted vegetables with cooked quinoa in a bowl. Whisk the remaining olive oil with red wine vinegar and lemon juice, drizzle over the salad, and toss with fresh mint before serving.

name: Ginger Soy Glazed Salmon with Jasmine Rice
instructions: Whisk together soy sauce, honey, ginger, and garlic to make the glaze. Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip and cook 3 more minutes. Pour the glaze over the salmon and let it bubble and thicken for 1 minute, spooning over the fish. Steam the bok choy briefly and serve everything over jasmine rice, topped with sesame seeds and scallions.

name: Chicken and Green Bean Stir-Fry over White Rice
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the sliced chicken for 5 minutes until golden, then set aside. Add the remaining oil, green beans, and bell pepper and stir-fry for 4 minutes until crisp-tender. Return the chicken, add garlic, ginger, coriander, and rice vinegar, and toss for 2 minutes. Serve over a generous portion of white rice and garnish with cilantro.

name: Vegan Coconut Cauliflower Curry with Rice
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a pot over medium heat and saute the garlic and ginger for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the curry powder, turmeric, and cumin and toast for 30 seconds to bloom the spices. Add the cauliflower and bell pepper, stir to coat, then pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes until the cauliflower is tender. Serve over white rice and garnish with fresh cilantro.

name: Garlic Butter Steak with Mushrooms
instructions: Pat the steak dry and season generously with salt and pepper, then let it rest at room temperature for 15 minutes. Heat olive oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat and sear the steak for 4 minutes per side for medium-rare. Add the butter, garlic, and thyme in the last minute, basting the steak with the foaming butter. Remove the steak to rest, then saute the mushrooms in the same pan for 5 minutes until browned, and serve alongside the sliced steak.

name: Baked Chicken Thighs with Herbed Cabbage and Rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400F and rub the chicken thighs with 1 tbsp olive oil, rosemary, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Roast on a sheet pan for 35 minutes until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear. Meanwhile, saute the shredded cabbage in the remaining olive oil over medium heat for 8 minutes until tender, finishing with lemon juice. Serve the chicken over white rice alongside the cabbage, garnished with parsley.

name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
instructions: Cook the fettuccine in salted boiling water until al dente, about 10 minutes, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water. Meanwhile, heat butter and olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and saute the mushrooms for 7 minutes until golden. Add the garlic and thyme for 1 minute, then pour in the heavy cream and parmesan, simmering until thickened. Toss in the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water, season with black pepper, and finish with fresh parsley.

name: Roasted Almond and Rice Cake Snack
ingredients: 1 tsp honey substitute or maple syrup
instructions: Spread almond butter evenly over the two rice cakes. Sprinkle with cinnamon and drizzle with maple syrup. Serve with roasted almonds on the side for extra crunch.

name: Cucumber and Turkey Roll-Up Snack Plate
instructions: Spread a thin layer of Dijon mustard on each slice of turkey breast. Wrap each slice around a cucumber spear and arrange on a plate. Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with dried dill and black pepper, and serve with a lemon wedge to squeeze over.

name: Southwest Egg White Scramble Breakfast Tacos
instructions: Warm a nonstick skillet over medium heat with the olive oil and saute the onion and bell pepper for 4 minutes until softened. Whisk the egg whites with cumin, smoked paprika, and garlic powder, then pour into the pan and scramble gently for 2-3 minutes until just set. Warm the corn tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side. Divide the scramble between tortillas, top with salsa and fresh cilantro, and serve immediately.

name: Steel-Cut Oats with Blueberries and Flax
instructions: Bring the water to a boil and stir in the steel-cut oats, reducing heat to a simmer. Cook uncovered for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until creamy and tender. Stir in the cinnamon, vanilla, and maple syrup during the last few minutes. Spoon into a bowl, top with blueberries, ground flaxseed, and a splash of almond milk before serving.

name: Avocado and Smoked Gouda Keto Omelette
instructions: Whisk the eggs with heavy cream, black pepper, and a small pinch of salt. Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat and pour in the eggs, letting them set for about a minute. Sprinkle the gouda over one half and cook until the eggs are just set, about 3 minutes. Fold the omelette over the cheese, slide onto a plate, and top with sliced avocado and chives.

name: Turkey Sausage and Rice Breakfast Bowl
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and brown the ground turkey with fennel seed, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper for 6-7 minutes. Add the bell pepper and cook 3 more minutes until softened. Push to one side and fry the two eggs to your liking. Spoon the warm white rice into a bowl, top with the turkey mixture and eggs, and garnish with parsley.

name: Tropical Mango Coconut Smoothie
instructions: Add the mango, coconut milk, water, lime juice, grated ginger, and maple syrup to a blender. Blend on high for 45-60 seconds until completely smooth. Pour into a tall glass and serve chilled.

name: Lemon Herb Chicken and White Rice Bowl
instructions: Toss the chicken breast with lemon zest, half the lemon juice, oregano, thyme, garlic, and black pepper and let it marinate for 10 minutes. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through, then rest and slice. Steam the green beans for 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Plate the warm white rice, top with sliced chicken and green beans, and finish with the remaining lemon juice and fresh parsley.

name: Spiced Chickpea and Cauliflower Grain Bowl
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425F. Toss the chickpeas and cauliflower with olive oil, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, and turmeric and spread on a baking sheet. Roast for 25 minutes, tossing halfway, until golden and crisp. Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and a splash of water to make a drizzle. Spoon the quinoa into a bowl, top with the roasted chickpeas and cauliflower, drizzle with tahini sauce, and garnish with cilantro.

name: Ginger Tofu and Cabbage White Rice Bowl
instructions: Press the tofu for 10 minutes then pat dry and cube. Heat the sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry the tofu 8-10 minutes until golden on all sides. Add the garlic, ginger, and chili flakes and cook 1 minute, then add the cabbage and stir-fry 4 minutes until wilted. Deglaze with rice vinegar, spoon over warm white rice, and finish with sesame seeds and scallion.

name: Hearty Beef and Barley Mushroom Stew
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef on all sides for 5 minutes, then remove. Saute the onion, carrot, and mushrooms for 5 minutes, then add garlic, thyme, and black pepper and cook 1 minute. Return the beef, add the barley, broth, and bay leaf, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a low simmer, cover, and cook for 60-70 minutes until the beef is tender and the barley is cooked. Discard the bay leaf, adjust pepper, and finish with fresh parsley.

name: Zesty Shrimp and Avocado Keto Salad
instructions: Whisk the olive oil, lime juice, chili powder, cumin, and black pepper into a dressing. Toss the mixed greens with half the dressing and arrange on a plate. Top with the cooked shrimp and diced avocado, drizzle with remaining dressing, and scatter cilantro over the top.

name: Egg White and Pepper Rice Lunch Bowl
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and saute the onion and bell pepper for 4 minutes. Whisk the egg whites with garlic powder and white pepper, pour into the pan, and scramble gently for 2-3 minutes. Fold in the warm white rice and lemon juice and heat through for 1 minute. Serve topped with fresh chives.

name: Miso Glazed Salmon with Jasmine Rice
instructions: Whisk the miso, honey, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil into a glaze. Preheat the oven to 400F, place the salmon on a lined tray, brush with the glaze, and bake for 12-14 minutes until it flakes. Steam the bok choy for 3-4 minutes until tender. Serve the salmon over jasmine rice alongside the bok choy, drizzled with pan glaze and topped with sesame seeds and scallion.

name: Herb Roasted Chicken with Green Beans and Rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400F. Rub the chicken breast with half the olive oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, and black pepper and roast on a tray for 22-25 minutes until cooked through, then rest and slice. Toss the green beans with the remaining oil and roast alongside for the last 15 minutes. Serve the sliced chicken and green beans over white rice, finishing with lemon juice and fresh parsley.

name: Creamy Coconut Vegetable Curry with Rice
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a pot over medium heat and bloom the curry powder, cumin, turmeric, ginger, and garlic for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the cauliflower, carrot, and green beans and stir to coat. Pour in the coconut milk and 1/2 cup water, bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15-18 minutes until the vegetables are tender. Serve the curry over warm white rice and garnish with cilantro.

name: Pan-Seared Cod with Lemon Butter Cauliflower Mash
instructions: Steam the cauliflower for 10 minutes until very soft, then mash with 1 tbsp butter, garlic, and black pepper until smooth. Pat the cod dry and season with dill and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high and sear the cod 3-4 minutes per side until it flakes. Melt the remaining butter with lemon zest and juice, spoon over the cod, and serve atop the cauliflower mash with chives.

name: Spaghetti with Garlicky Turkey Meat Sauce
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in boiling water until al dente, then drain and reserve a splash of pasta water. Heat the olive oil in a skillet and brown the turkey for 6 minutes, breaking it apart. Add the onion and garlic and cook 3 minutes, then stir in oregano, dried basil, chili flakes, and black pepper. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes until thickened. Toss the sauce with the spaghetti and a splash of pasta water, then serve topped with fresh basil.

name: Pork Chop with Sauteed Cabbage and Rice
instructions: Season the pork chop with smoked paprika, thyme, and black pepper. Heat half the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high and sear the pork 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through, then rest. In the same pan add the remaining oil and garlic, then saute the cabbage for 6 minutes until tender, finishing with apple cider vinegar. Slice the pork and serve over white rice alongside the cabbage, garnished with parsley.

name: Roasted Red Pepper and Herb Hummus Snack Plate
instructions: Spoon the hummus into a small bowl and swirl in the olive oil and a pinch of smoked paprika. Arrange the cucumber, carrot sticks, and bell pepper strips around the bowl. Garnish the hummus with fresh parsley and serve.

name: Vanilla Almond Protein Chia Pudding
instructions: Whisk the almond milk with the vanilla protein powder, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and maple syrup until smooth. Stir in the chia seeds, then let sit 5 minutes and stir again to prevent clumping. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight until thick. Top with sliced almonds before serving.

name: Everything Deviled Avocado Keto Bites
instructions: Halve the hard-boiled eggs and scoop the yolks into a bowl. Mash the yolks with the avocado, dijon mustard, lemon juice, garlic powder, and black pepper until creamy. Spoon or pipe the filling back into the egg white halves. Sprinkle with everything bagel seasoning and chives before serving.

name: Fluffy Egg White Scramble with Zucchini and White Rice
instructions: Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and saute the zucchini and bell pepper for 4 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and smoked paprika and cook 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the egg whites and gently scramble for 2-3 minutes until just set. Stir in the warm white rice, lemon juice, and black pepper, then finish with fresh parsley and serve.

name: Steak and Eggs Keto Breakfast Plate with Avocado
instructions: Season the steak with garlic powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper. Sear in olive oil over high heat for 3-4 minutes per side for medium, then rest 5 minutes. Fry the eggs in butter over medium heat until the whites are set but yolks runny. Plate the steak with the eggs and sliced avocado, finish with chives and more black pepper.

name: Blueberry Banana Oatmeal with Flaxseed
instructions: Combine oats and almond milk in a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring for 5-6 minutes until creamy. Stir in cinnamon, vanilla, and maple syrup. Top with sliced banana, blueberries, and flaxseed before serving warm.

name: Tofu and Bell Pepper Breakfast Rice Bowl
instructions: Press the tofu to remove moisture, then crumble into chunks. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the tofu for 6 minutes until golden. Add the bell peppers, turmeric, cumin, and black pepper and cook another 4 minutes. Fold in the warm rice, finish with lime juice and cilantro, and serve.

name: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Keto Stack
instructions: Spread cream cheese onto cucumber slices arranged on a plate. Layer the smoked salmon over the top. Scatter capers, fresh dill, lemon zest, and black pepper over everything and serve chilled.

name: Grilled Lemon Herb Chicken over White Rice and Green Beans
instructions: Marinate the chicken in 1 tbsp olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic, thyme, oregano, and black pepper for 15 minutes. Grill or pan-sear over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through, then rest and slice. Steam the green beans for 4 minutes until tender-crisp and toss with remaining olive oil. Serve the chicken over warm white rice with green beans alongside.

name: Chickpea and Roasted Veggie Mediterranean Bowl
instructions: Preheat oven to 425F and toss the zucchini, onion, and chickpeas with 1 tbsp olive oil, cumin, and smoked paprika. Roast for 20 minutes until golden, stirring once. Whisk tahini, lemon juice, remaining olive oil, and a splash of water into a dressing. Serve the roasted vegetables and chickpeas over quinoa, drizzle with dressing, and top with parsley.

name: Shrimp Fried Rice with Peas and Egg
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat and cook the shrimp for 2 minutes until pink, then set aside. Scramble the beaten eggs in the same wok for 1 minute and push aside. Add the ginger, garlic, and peas and carrots and stir-fry 2 minutes. Add the rice, breaking up clumps, then stir in soy sauce and sesame oil and fry for 3 minutes. Return the shrimp, toss with green onions, and serve hot.

name: Turkey and Cabbage White Rice Lunch Bowl
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the ground turkey for 6 minutes, breaking it up. Add garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin, and black pepper and cook 1 minute. Add the cabbage and remaining oil and saute 5 minutes until wilted. Stir in rice vinegar, fold in the warm rice, and finish with cilantro.

name: Avocado Egg Salad Lettuce Wraps
instructions: Mash the avocado with Dijon mustard and lemon juice in a bowl. Fold in the chopped eggs, celery, dill, and black pepper. Spoon the mixture into the lettuce leaves and serve as wraps.

name: White Fish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Season the tilapia with chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, and black pepper. Pan-sear in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side until flaky. Toss the cabbage with lime juice, remaining olive oil, and cilantro to make a quick slaw. Warm the tortillas, flake the fish into them, top with slaw, and serve with extra lime.

name: Hearty Beef and Vegetable Rice Skillet
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the ground beef for 6 minutes, breaking it apart. Add onion, carrots, and green beans and cook 5 minutes until softening. Stir in garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, and black pepper and cook 1 minute. Fold in the cooked rice and heat through for 3 minutes, then finish with parsley and serve.

name: Baked Lemon Herb Cod with White Rice and Zucchini
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F and place the cod on a lined baking sheet. Drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic, dill, thyme, and black pepper. Bake for 14-16 minutes until flaky. Saute the zucchini in remaining olive oil for 4 minutes. Serve the cod over white rice with zucchini alongside.

name: Creamy Coconut Chicken Curry with Jasmine Rice
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a pot over medium heat and brown the chicken for 5 minutes. Add onion and bell pepper and cook 4 minutes until softened. Stir in ginger, garlic, curry powder, and turmeric and cook 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in the coconut milk, bring to a simmer, and cook 12 minutes until the chicken is tender and sauce thickens. Finish with lime juice and cilantro and serve over jasmine rice.

name: Garlic Butter Pork Chop with Cauliflower Mash
instructions: Season the pork chop with black pepper and rosemary. Sear in olive oil over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes per side, then add 1 tbsp butter, garlic, and thyme and baste for 1 minute; rest the chop. Steam the cauliflower for 10 minutes until very tender, then mash with remaining butter and heavy cream until smooth. Serve the pork chop with the cauliflower mash and spoon over the pan butter.

name: Vegan Ginger Tofu Stir-Fry with White Rice
instructions: Press and cube the tofu, then pan-fry in 2 tbsp vegetable oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until golden on all sides. Add the remaining oil, ginger, garlic, cabbage, and bell pepper and stir-fry for 4 minutes. Stir in rice vinegar, sesame oil, and white pepper. Fold in the cooked rice, toss with green onions, and serve hot.

name: Spaghetti with Roasted Garlic Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in boiling water until al dente, then drain and reserve 1/4 cup pasta water. Saute the onion in olive oil over medium heat for 4 minutes, then add mushrooms and cook 8 minutes until browned. Add garlic, thyme, and chili flakes and cook 1 minute. Stir in almond milk, nutritional yeast, and reserved pasta water and simmer 3 minutes into a creamy sauce. Toss with the spaghetti, season with black pepper, and finish with parsley.

name: Roasted Almond and Dark Chocolate Energy Bites
instructions: Pulse the almonds, oats, dates, cocoa powder, vanilla, and cinnamon in a food processor until a sticky dough forms. Fold in the dark chocolate chips. Roll into bite-sized balls and chill for 20 minutes before serving.

name: Cucumber and Shrimp Chilled Snack Plate
instructions: Arrange the chilled shrimp and cucumber slices on a plate. Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, dill, and black pepper into a quick dressing. Drizzle over the plate and serve immediately.

name: Rice Cake with Sunflower Butter and Berries
instructions: Spread sunflower seed butter evenly over the rice cakes. Top with blueberries and a sprinkle of cinnamon. Drizzle with maple syrup and serve.

name: Lemon Herb Tofu Breakfast Scramble with Rice
instructions: Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and add the minced garlic, cooking until fragrant. Add the diced bell pepper and saute for 3 minutes until softened. Add the crumbled tofu and turmeric, stirring to coat, and cook for 5 minutes until lightly golden. Stir in the cooked white rice and warm through. Finish with lemon juice, black pepper, and fresh parsley before serving.

name: Cinnamon Apple Rice Porridge
instructions: Combine the cooked white rice and rice milk in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Stir in the cinnamon and simmer gently for 5 minutes until creamy. In a separate pan, saute the diced apple in olive oil until softened. Top the porridge with the warm apple and drizzle with maple syrup before serving.

name: Coconut Blueberry Rice Pudding Bowl
instructions: Warm the cooked white rice with the light coconut milk in a saucepan over medium-low heat. Add vanilla extract and cinnamon and simmer for 6 minutes, stirring until thick and creamy. Pour into a bowl and top with fresh blueberries and a drizzle of maple syrup.

name: Herbed Tofu and Zucchini Breakfast Hash
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and add the cubed tofu, cooking until golden on all sides. Add the garlic, zucchini, oregano, and paprika and saute for 5 minutes until the zucchini is tender. Stir in the cooked white rice and warm through. Garnish with chopped chives and serve.

name: Maple Cinnamon Rice Cakes with Apple
instructions: Spread a thin layer of sunflower seed butter over each rice cake. Arrange the thin apple slices on top. Drizzle with maple syrup and dust with cinnamon before serving.

name: Cabbage and Carrot Spring Roll Snack
ingredients: 2 oz firm tofu, sliced into strips
instructions: Soak each rice paper wrapper in warm water for a few seconds until pliable. Lay flat and arrange the shredded cabbage, carrot, tofu strips, and mint leaves in the center. Drizzle with rice vinegar and lime juice, then roll tightly, folding in the sides. Slice in half and serve immediately.

name: Ginger Sesame Tofu Lettuce Cups
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and add the diced tofu, cooking until browned. Add the ginger, garlic, and bell pepper and saute for 3 minutes. Stir in the soy sauce and rice vinegar and cook for 1 minute more. Spoon the tofu mixture and warm white rice into the lettuce leaves and serve as cups.

name: Vegan Cauliflower Fried Rice
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the garlic and ginger, stirring until fragrant. Add the crumbled tofu and cook for 4 minutes until golden. Stir in the riced cauliflower, bell pepper, and peas and saute for 5 minutes. Add the cooked white rice and soy sauce and toss everything together for 2 minutes. Garnish with sliced green onions and serve.

name: Mediterranean Herb Tofu Rice Bowl
instructions: Toss the cubed tofu with oregano and garlic, then pan-fry in olive oil over medium-high heat until golden on all sides. Arrange the cooked white rice in a bowl and top with the tofu, diced cucumber, and bell pepper. Drizzle with lemon juice and remaining olive oil, then garnish with fresh parsley.

name: Thai Basil Tofu Stir-Fry over Rice
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a wok over high heat and add the tofu, stir-frying until crisp. Add the garlic, ginger, bell pepper, and green beans and stir-fry for 5 minutes until crisp-tender. Add the soy sauce and lime juice and toss to coat. Remove from heat and stir in the fresh basil until wilted. Serve over cooked white rice.

name: Chilled Cabbage Rice Noodle Salad
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package directions, then rinse under cold water and drain. Pan-fry the tofu in a little sesame oil until golden, then set aside. Whisk together the remaining sesame oil, rice vinegar, soy sauce, ginger, and lime juice to make a dressing. Toss the noodles with the cabbage, carrot, tofu, and dressing. Garnish with cilantro and serve chilled.

name: Hearty Vegan Tofu and Vegetable Rice Skillet
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the tofu until deeply golden on all sides, then remove. Add the remaining olive oil and saute the garlic, green beans, bell pepper, and cabbage with smoked paprika and thyme for 6 minutes. Return the tofu to the skillet and stir in the cooked white rice and soy sauce, tossing to combine and heating through. Garnish with parsley and serve.

name: Coconut Curry Tofu with Jasmine Rice
instructions: Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and cook the tofu until golden, then set aside. Saute the garlic and ginger, then add the curry powder and turmeric and toast for 30 seconds. Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer, then add the bell pepper and green beans, cooking for 6 minutes until tender. Return the tofu to the sauce and simmer for 2 minutes. Finish with lime juice and cilantro and serve over jasmine rice.

name: Garlic Ginger Tofu and Green Bean Dinner
instructions: Press and slice the tofu, then pan-fry in sesame oil over medium-high heat until golden and crisp. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the green beans and stir-fry for 5 minutes until crisp-tender. Stir in the soy sauce and rice vinegar and toss to coat. Serve over white rice and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Vegan Stuffed Bell Peppers with Rice
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers, halved and seeded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Heat olive oil in a skillet and saute the garlic and crumbled tofu with oregano, cumin, and paprika for 5 minutes. Stir in the cooked white rice and lemon juice. Spoon the mixture into the bell pepper halves and place them in a baking dish. Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes until the peppers are tender. Garnish with parsley and serve.

name: Sesame Tofu and Cabbage Stir-Fry Bowl
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a wok over high heat and fry the tofu until golden and crisp, then remove. Add the remaining sesame oil and stir-fry the garlic, ginger, cabbage, and bell pepper for 5 minutes until wilted. Return the tofu and add the soy sauce and rice vinegar, tossing to combine. Serve over white rice and top with sesame seeds and green onions.

name: Lemon Herb Roasted Cauliflower and Rice Plate
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Toss the cauliflower florets and tofu with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, garlic, thyme, and black pepper, then spread on a baking sheet. Roast for 25 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and tender. Toss the cooked white rice with the remaining olive oil, lemon zest, and lemon juice. Plate the rice, top with the roasted cauliflower and tofu, and garnish with parsley.

name: Vegan Tofu Vegetable Rice Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat and saute the garlic and ginger until fragrant. Add the green beans, carrot, and bell pepper and cook for 3 minutes. Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a simmer, then add the tofu and cook for 8 minutes. Stir in the cooked white rice and warm through. Garnish with cilantro and serve.

name: Spiced Rice and Veggie Breakfast Bowl
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and saute the garlic and crumbled tofu with cumin, paprika, and turmeric for 4 minutes. Add the bell pepper and cabbage and cook for 4 minutes until softened. Stir in the cooked white rice and warm through. Finish with lime juice and serve in a bowl.

name: Zucchini Rice Fritters with Herb Dip
instructions: Squeeze the excess moisture from the grated zucchini, then mix with the cooked white rice, rice flour, garlic, and dill until it holds together. Form into small patties. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and pan-fry the fritters for 3 minutes per side until golden. Stir together the coconut yogurt, lemon juice, and chives for a dip and serve alongside the warm fritters.

name: Golden Turmeric Tofu Breakfast Scramble
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the diced bell pepper and cook for 3 minutes until softened. Crumble in the tofu and sprinkle with turmeric, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Stir and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until the tofu is golden and warmed through. Stir in the nutritional yeast and green onions, cook 1 more minute, then garnish with parsley and serve.

name: Coconut Mango Breakfast Rice
instructions: Combine the cooked rice and coconut milk in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir in the cardamom, vanilla, and maple syrup, warming gently for 4 to 5 minutes until creamy. Spoon into a bowl, top with diced mango and toasted shredded coconut, and serve warm.

name: Blueberry Buckwheat Porridge
instructions: Rinse the buckwheat groats thoroughly under cold water. Combine them with the almond milk and cinnamon in a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook covered for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender and creamy. Stir in the vanilla, maple syrup, and chia seeds. Top with fresh blueberries and serve warm.

name: Savory Chickpea Flour Pancake
instructions: Whisk the chickpea flour with water, turmeric, cumin, and black pepper until smooth, then let the batter rest for 10 minutes. Stir in the diced onion and cilantro. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and pour in the batter, spreading it into a round. Cook for 4 minutes per side until golden and set. Slide onto a plate and serve warm.

name: Thai Peanut Tofu Rice Bowl
instructions: Press the tofu and cut into cubes. Heat the sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high and sear the tofu until golden on all sides, about 8 minutes. Whisk the peanut butter, tamari, lime juice, and ginger with a splash of water to make a sauce. Arrange rice in a bowl, top with tofu, shredded carrot, and cabbage, drizzle with the peanut sauce, and garnish with chopped peanuts.

name: Mediterranean Herbed Quinoa Bowl
instructions: Fluff the cooked quinoa and let it cool slightly in a bowl. Add the diced cucumber, bell pepper, parsley, mint, and olives. Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, and black pepper together and pour over the salad. Toss well to combine and serve at room temperature or chilled.

name: Cauliflower Chickpea Curry Bowl
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and saute the garlic and ginger for 1 minute. Add the curry powder, cumin, and coriander and toast for 30 seconds. Add the cauliflower florets and chickpeas, stir to coat, then pour in the coconut milk. Simmer covered for 12 to 15 minutes until the cauliflower is tender. Serve over the white rice and garnish with cilantro.

name: Zesty Lemon Lentil Soup
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat and saute the onion, carrot, and celery for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin, and turmeric and cook 1 minute more. Stir in the rinsed lentils and broth, bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 20 minutes until the lentils break down. Stir in the lemon juice and black pepper, and serve hot.

name: Smoky Black Bean Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190C. Halve and seed the bell peppers and place them in a baking dish. Combine the black beans, rice, corn, smoked paprika, cumin, chili powder, cilantro, and lime juice in a bowl. Spoon the filling into the pepper halves, drizzle with olive oil, and cover with foil. Bake for 25 minutes, then uncover and bake 10 more minutes until the peppers are tender.

name: Ginger Sesame Tofu Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and sear the tofu cubes until golden, about 7 minutes. Push to the side and add the broccoli and bell pepper, stir-frying for 4 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute. Whisk the tamari and maple syrup together, pour over the stir-fry, and toss to coat. Serve over white rice sprinkled with sesame seeds.

name: Hearty Mushroom Walnut Bolognese
instructions: Cook the gluten-free spaghetti according to package directions, then drain. Heat the olive oil in a skillet and saute the onion and garlic for 4 minutes. Add the mushrooms and walnuts and cook until the mushrooms release their moisture, about 6 minutes. Stir in the crushed tomatoes, oregano, basil, and black pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes. Toss with the spaghetti and garnish with fresh basil.

name: Coconut Vegetable Red Curry Noodles
instructions: Soak or cook the rice noodles according to package directions and set aside. Heat the coconut oil in a pot and stir in the red curry paste and ginger, cooking for 1 minute. Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer. Add the snap peas, bell pepper, and carrot and cook for 5 minutes until crisp-tender. Stir in the lime juice, add the noodles, toss to combine, and garnish with basil.

name: Overnight Oats with Strawberries and Chia
instructions: Combine oats, soy milk, chia seeds, flaxseed, cinnamon, and maple syrup in a jar. Stir well to distribute the chia seeds. Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least 6 hours. In the morning, stir again and top with fresh sliced strawberries before serving.

name: Savory Oatmeal with Sauteed Mushrooms and Kale
instructions: Cook the oats with water over medium heat until creamy, about 5 minutes. Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a skillet and saute garlic until fragrant. Add mushrooms and cook until browned, then stir in kale and cook until wilted. Season with black pepper and smoked paprika. Stir nutritional yeast into the cooked oats, then top with the sauteed vegetables and serve warm.

name: Apple Cinnamon Buckwheat Bowl
instructions: Rinse the buckwheat groats under cold water. Simmer them with almond milk and cinnamon over low heat until tender and creamy, about 15 minutes. Stir in the diced apple and raisins during the last few minutes of cooking. Sweeten with maple syrup, top with chopped walnuts, and serve warm.

name: Tofu and Veggie Breakfast Wrap
instructions: Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Saute onion and bell pepper until softened. Add crumbled tofu, turmeric, cumin, and black pepper, and cook until heated through and slightly golden, about 5 minutes. Warm the tortilla, then fill it with the tofu scramble, avocado slices, and salsa. Roll up tightly and serve.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad Pita
instructions: In a bowl, lightly mash half the chickpeas with a fork and leave the rest whole. Add cucumber, red onion, and parsley. Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, and black pepper, then toss with the chickpea mixture. Warm the pita, cut it in half, and stuff with the chickpea salad before serving.

name: Spiced Red Lentil and Carrot Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot and saute onion, garlic, and carrots until softened. Stir in cumin, coriander, and turmeric and cook until fragrant. Add the rinsed red lentils and vegetable broth, then bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until the lentils are soft and broken down, about 20 minutes. Stir in lemon juice, blend partially if desired, and garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.

name: Quinoa Black Bean Burrito Bowl
instructions: Warm the black beans with cumin and chili powder in a small pan. Build the bowl with a base of cooked quinoa, then arrange the beans, corn, and bell pepper on top. Add diced avocado and salsa, then drizzle with lime juice. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve.

name: Roasted Vegetable and Hummus Grain Bowl
instructions: Preheat oven to 425F. Toss zucchini, bell pepper, and onion with olive oil, thyme, and black pepper, then roast on a baking sheet for 20 to 25 minutes until tender and caramelized. Place the cooked farro in a bowl and top with the roasted vegetables. Add a dollop of hummus, drizzle with lemon juice, and garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

name: Thai Peanut Vegetable Noodle Bowl
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package directions, then rinse under cold water. Whisk together peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, and maple syrup, adding a splash of water to thin into a sauce. Toss the noodles with carrot, cabbage, and edamame, then coat with the peanut sauce. Top with chopped scallions and serve at room temperature or chilled.

name: Stuffed Acorn Squash with Wild Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F. Brush the cut sides of the acorn squash with a little olive oil and roast cut-side down for 35 to 40 minutes until tender. Meanwhile, saute onion and celery in olive oil until soft, then stir in the cooked wild rice, cranberries, pecans, sage, thyme, and black pepper. Fill each squash half with the rice mixture and return to the oven for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Moroccan Chickpea and Vegetable Tagine
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot and saute onion and garlic until soft. Stir in cumin, cinnamon, and paprika, cooking until fragrant. Add carrot, zucchini, chickpeas, apricots, and vegetable broth, then simmer covered until the vegetables are tender, about 25 minutes. Serve the tagine over cooked couscous and garnish with fresh cilantro.

name: Teriyaki Tofu and Broccoli Stir-Fry
instructions: Press the tofu to remove excess moisture, then cube it. Heat sesame oil in a skillet and brown the tofu on all sides. Add broccoli and bell pepper, stir-frying until crisp-tender. Whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, maple syrup, ginger, and garlic, then pour over the stir-fry and toss to coat. Serve over brown rice and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Lemon Dill Egg White Breakfast Cups
instructions: Preheat oven to 375F and lightly grease two muffin cups with olive oil. Whisk the egg whites with black pepper, lemon zest, and dill. Stir in the cooked white rice and diced bell pepper. Divide the mixture into the muffin cups and bake for 18 to 20 minutes until set. Finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice before serving.

name: Cinnamon Pear Cream of Rice Porridge
ingredients: 1 tsp olive oil or vegan butter
instructions: Bring the rice milk to a gentle simmer in a small saucepan. Whisk in the cream of rice cereal and cook, stirring constantly, for about 3 minutes until thick. Stir in cinnamon, nutmeg, and maple syrup. Meanwhile, saute the diced pear in olive oil until softened and lightly caramelized. Top the porridge with the warm pear and serve.

name: Herbed Tofu and Bell Pepper Breakfast Skillet
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the diced bell pepper and saute for 3 minutes until softened. Add the crumbled tofu, turmeric, garlic powder, and black pepper, and cook for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. Stir in the cooked white rice and heat through. Finish with fresh parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.

name: Apple Rice Cake Breakfast Stack
instructions: Spread the sunflower seed butter evenly over the two rice cakes. Arrange the thin apple slices on top. Sprinkle with ground cinnamon and drizzle lightly with maple syrup. Serve immediately for a quick crunchy breakfast.

name: Ginger Chicken and Cabbage Rice Lunch
instructions: Heat half the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken slices until golden and cooked through, about 6 minutes. Remove and set aside. Add the remaining oil, ginger, and garlic, and stir for 30 seconds. Add the shredded cabbage and cook until wilted but crisp, about 4 minutes. Return the chicken, add rice vinegar and black pepper, and toss. Serve over warm white rice topped with fresh cilantro.

name: Lemon Herb Shrimp Rice Bowl with Green Beans
instructions: Steam or boil the green beans for 4 minutes until crisp-tender, then drain. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and add the garlic for 30 seconds. Add the shrimp and cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side until pink. Stir in lemon juice, lemon zest, and black pepper. Serve the shrimp and green beans over warm white rice and garnish with parsley.

name: Turkey and Bell Pepper Cabbage Wraps
instructions: Blanch the cabbage leaves in boiling water for 1 minute to soften, then pat dry. Heat the olive oil in a skillet and cook the ground turkey with smoked paprika and garlic powder until browned, about 6 minutes. Stir in the diced bell pepper and cooked rice and heat through. Add lime juice and cilantro. Spoon the filling into each cabbage leaf and roll up to serve.

name: Chilled Cucumber Rice Noodle Lunch
instructions: Cook the rice vermicelli according to package directions, then rinse under cold water and drain. Pan-fry the tofu cubes in olive oil until golden on all sides. Whisk together rice vinegar, sesame oil, and grated ginger for the dressing. Toss the chilled noodles with cucumber, carrot, tofu, and dressing. Garnish with fresh mint and serve cold.

name: Baked Lemon Tilapia with Rice Pilaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F. Place the tilapia on a parchment-lined tray, drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, and black pepper, and bake for 12 to 15 minutes until flaky. Meanwhile, saute the garlic, carrot, and peas in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes, then stir in the cooked rice to make a pilaf. Plate the rice pilaf and top with the baked tilapia and fresh dill.

name: Garlic Herb Tofu with Roasted Cauliflower and Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425F. Toss the cauliflower florets with 1.5 tbsp olive oil, smoked paprika, and black pepper, and roast for 25 minutes until golden. Press the tofu and pan-fry in the remaining olive oil with garlic and oregano until crisp on all sides. Warm the cooked white rice. Combine the tofu, cauliflower, and rice on a plate, drizzle with lemon juice, and garnish with fresh parsley.

name: Lemon Poppyseed Cream of Rice Bowl
instructions: Bring the rice milk to a gentle simmer in a small saucepan. Whisk in the cream of rice cereal slowly to avoid lumps and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until thick. Stir in the maple syrup, lemon zest, vanilla, and cinnamon. Spoon into a bowl and sprinkle the poppyseeds over the top before serving warm.

name: Blueberry Lemon Breakfast Rice Cakes
instructions: Spread the dairy-free cream cheese evenly over both rice cakes. Scatter the fresh blueberries on top and press them in lightly so they stick. Sprinkle with lemon zest and drizzle with a thin stream of maple syrup. Serve immediately while the rice cakes are still crisp.

name: Herbed Egg White Scramble with Red Pepper
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and add the diced red bell pepper. Sauté for 3 minutes until softened, then add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Pour in the egg whites and let them set slightly before gently scrambling. Season with black pepper and dill, then fold in the fresh chives just before the eggs finish cooking. Serve hot.

name: Cinnamon Apple Rice Breakfast Skillet
instructions: Melt the vegan margarine in a skillet over medium heat and add the diced apple. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the apple softens and begins to caramelize. Stir in the cinnamon and nutmeg, then add the cooked white rice. Drizzle with maple syrup and toss everything together, cooking another 2 minutes until warmed through. Serve warm in a bowl.

name: Grilled Herb Chicken with Cabbage Rice
instructions: Rub the chicken breast with 1 tablespoon olive oil, oregano, paprika, and black pepper. Grill over medium-high heat for 5 to 6 minutes per side until cooked through, then let it rest and slice. Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a skillet and sauté the garlic and shredded cabbage for 5 minutes until tender. Stir the cooked rice into the cabbage and squeeze in the lemon juice. Plate the rice and cabbage and top with the sliced chicken.

name: Teriyaki-Style Tofu and Green Bean Rice Bowl
instructions: Press the tofu to remove excess moisture, then cube it. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the tofu on all sides until golden, about 8 minutes. Add the green beans and cook for 4 minutes until crisp-tender. Whisk together the soy sauce, ginger, garlic, rice vinegar, and maple syrup, then pour over the tofu and beans and toss to coat. Serve over the cooked white rice and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Chilled Shrimp and Cucumber Rice Salad
instructions: Combine the cooled white rice, diced cucumber, and cooked shrimp in a large bowl. Whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, and black pepper to make a light dressing. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently. Fold in the fresh dill and chill for 15 minutes before serving.

name: Garlic Lime Pork and Pepper Rice Plate
instructions: Toss the sliced pork with cumin, smoked paprika, and black pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the pork for 4 to 5 minutes until browned and cooked through, then set aside. Add the remaining oil, garlic, and bell pepper to the skillet and sauté for 4 minutes. Return the pork to the pan, add the lime juice, and toss. Serve over white rice and garnish with cilantro.
